response.sql: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), deviations AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, average_unit_price - (SELECT AVG(average_unit_price) FROM invoice_averages) AS deviation_from_overall FROM invoice_averages), comparisons AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation_from_overall, deviation_from_overall - AVG(deviation_from_overall) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_minus_country_average FROM deviations) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation_from_overall, deviation_minus_country_average FROM comparisons ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_average IS NULL, deviation_minus_country_average DESC, InvoiceId LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average gives each invoice with lines equal weight; deviation is the signed difference from that average. Invoices without lines have NULL averages and sort last.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average pools all invoice lines, giving invoices with more lines more weight.
